content.text: {"core": "Change ends what has finished and lets the next form take its place. In Breakthrough, it works on the sudden collapse — the moment a structure gives way all at once. Unacknowledged, the ending runs without being named: the old form is already gone, yet the collapse gets treated as damage to repair rather than a clearing that finished its work.","sheetLine": "The thing already ended; the wreckage is being patched as if it could still stand."}
